note: The Meta-World checkpoint of SmolVLA from LeRobot: the same model and preprocessing as smolvla-base (vlm_model_name HuggingFaceTB/SmolVLM2-500M-Video-Instruct, resize to fit 512 × 512 padded on the LEFT and TOP, 64 visual tokens per frame), with 1 camera input in its config. No inference time or control rate is stated for it. Licence Apache-2.0 (model card). DexVantage bundles these figures only, not the model.

crop_rule.quote: vla_utils.resize_with_pad: "Resize a (b, c, h, w) image without distortion, padding on the LEFT and TOP. This is the smolvla/xvla convention."

tokens_per_image.quote: "We use the global image only, in addition to a pixel shuffle operation, limiting the visual tokens to 64 per frame."
